rules.statement: The notice of intended application must be given to the parties who would be prejudicially affected by the success of the proposed appeal, as per the interpretation of 'opposite party' in Rule 2.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not find it possible to agree that that circumstance has the effect of preventing the objecting defendants being the 'opposite party' to the 19th defendant, the petitioner. ... The expression 'opposite party' must mean the party or parties who would be prejudicially affected by the success of the proposed appeal and would, therefore, naturally be opposed to the granting of the remedy or relief sought for by the proposed appellant."
